answer: Bonded vouching with slashing kills the sybil fable that identities are free. Each new agent needs a vouch from an established peer who locks real capital; if the newcomer cheats, that bond drains like a lagoon through a cracked seawall. To field a thousand fake, plume-light identities an attacker must post a thousand slashable bonds, so the cost scales linearly with the deception instead of collapsing toward zero.
